blindReviewDeclaration: Independent source-first findings and verdict were formed before reading author intake or handoff.
expectedBehavior: Sixteen reads remove all transaction re-entry without changing command transactions.
Five commands derive two reachable owners from a finite source authority.
Candidate reconciliation, accepted budgets and PRE POST comparison cannot self-certify.

findings.title: Coordinator path was nonexistent
findings.evidence: The reviewed manifest named apps/backend/catering-business-server/src/main/java/com/catering/v2s/app/application/CatalogInventoryCoordinator.java; the real class is modules/catalog/src/main/java/com/catering/v2s/catalog/application/CatalogInventoryCoordinator.java.
findings.risk: The implementation denominator could miss all sixteen real transaction origins.
findings.disposition: Bind the actual module path and method anchors.

findings.title: Owner API mapping authority was unspecified
findings.evidence: The generator currently exposes one ownerBoundary and the reviewed design named no finite API-type-to-owner registry or source-inventory self-test surface.
findings.risk: A heuristic can miscount imports, nested APIs or same-owner duplicates.
findings.disposition: Add a source-hash-bound finite API registry and complete reachability red fixtures.

findings.title: Candidate recovery fallback was not auditable
findings.evidence: Accepted evidence stores only 721 and a fingerprint; reviewed design had no finite recovery-location denominator or closed exclusion reasons.
findings.risk: Generic dispositions could turn historical uncertainty into a false reconciliation.
findings.disposition: Hash-bind finite recovery locations, emit OLD_ROW_SET_UNRECOVERABLE when applicable, and close disposition vocabulary and source evidence.

findings.title: Budget increase was self-approvable
findings.evidence: A literal APPROVED plus arbitrary same-package evidence could satisfy the reviewed history schema.
findings.risk: Current and accepted values could rise together and bypass the ratchet.
findings.disposition: Require a pre-existing Dexter authority artifact outside the implementation changed set and red-test same-package self-approval.

findings.title: Detailed sequence captured PRE after production changes
findings.evidence: Reviewed design section 5.1 placed U01-U04 before comparator and PRE while the manifest placed PRE first.
findings.risk: An optimized state could be mislabeled as baseline.
findings.disposition: Make comparator and PRE capture precede every production behavior edit and bind entry source hashes.

findings.title: PRE and POST workload equality was incomplete
findings.evidence: The comparator checked operation IDs but not per-operation callCount or stageIds, and report producer/test surfaces plus terminal cleanup identity were omitted.
findings.risk: A smaller POST workload could falsely appear improved.
findings.disposition: Exact-match operation call counts and stage IDs, bind fixture identity and terminal business cleanup, and cover producer plus tests.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: Correct target problems, incomplete executable contracts.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: Extend existing generators, scanner, P4 and comparator; no second runner is needed.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: Proportionate after exact source and evidence contracts close.

conclusion.summary: Five blocking and one serious design gaps required source-bound remediation before Claude handoff.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: Read-only DESIGN review only; no implementation, Testcontainers, DEV, L2, reset, seed or performance authority.
